description: Find and verify the professional (work) email of a person you can name: give their first name, last name and the company they work at (its domain, such as acme.com, matches best; a company name also works). Returns the address with a confidence label (Verified or Likely) and their LinkedIn profile when it can be matched. Spends 2 credits, refunded automatically if no email is found. People who asked to be removed from PeopleSearch.im are never looked up. To find people you cannot name yet, use people_search or find_people, then fetch_email.

company_or_domain.description: The company they work at: its domain (best, e.g. acme.com) or its name.

name: find_work_email
title: Find a person's work email
